name: Red Cottage
description: A falu-red cottage by the woods near Punkanjoki: a woodshed, an apple tree and its own little sauna. There is only one, and it is for sale.
greeting: Birds sing in the birch trees.
The apple tree is in bloom.

hello: The previous owner had such nice roses.
You should put the sauna on. It's Saturday somewhere.
buy: Oh how lovely, a young person moving in!
move_in: Back home! I watered the plants.
relax: Enjoy the sauna, dear. I'll keep an eye on things.
broke: Ooh, it's not cheap, is it? Save up, dear.

effects.message: The cottage is yours! You move in right away.

actions.label: Relax at the cottage
actions.description: Wood-fired sauna and a swim in the river.

effects.message: Wood-fired sauna, a cold dip, a sausage on the fire. Bliss.
